name: llmc_matmul_backward_bias
goal: Port matmul_backward_bias_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/matmul_backward_bias.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> B T C OC` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 1 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: migrate's output under migrated/ counts, so delete it (delete_file) once your own port is done. migrate's output can be long: read it in parts (read_file offset/limit) or work from the CUDA harness.

museport.note: B=4, T=256, OC=1024 (llm.c: B=8, T=1024, OC=3072); C=768 as in llm.c (unused in bias reduction); OC kept multiple of 256/32/8 for kernels 4,7-9; tol 1.0 matches bf16 branch in llm.c main.
